g.text: System design / verified answer release + durable research recovery
Mastra agent service / same process, persistent SQLite
reuse saved work; up to 2 retries
read active corpus / check release identity
Verified answer or fixed withheld notice
Draft text never enters the stream
Same public run ID on recovery
Guard history, recall and clone reads
02 CORPUS RELEASE — build a candidate, validate, promote
Solid arrows: request / data flow Dashed arrows: background work or external dependency Orange: persisted data
Recovery: two attempts per run, 30s / 120s backoff; exhausted limits and failed grounding are terminal. No separate queue or worker service.
